top_signals.title: Iran Targets Bahrain Base, But Stays Open to US Deal
top_signals.summary: Iran targeted Bahrain for the second time in three days, as the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps said Sunday it launched six drones at the radar of a US air defense site at the Riffa base. The Islamic republic reiterated that a path to ending its conflict with the US remains open. Abeer Abu Omar reports on Bloomberg Television. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: New North Sea Gas Supply Comes Online Amid Growing Political Backlash
top_signals.summary: Natural gas started flowing from the Jackdaw production platform in the UK North Sea less than a month after Britain approved the project, but the future of a larger proposed oil and gas project, Rosebank, hangs in the balance amid a political backlash. Jackdaw gas will funnel through the existing Shearwater production hub and onwards to the St Fergus gas terminal in Aberdeenshire, Scotland, before being supplied to homes and businesses across Britain, the Jackdaw project’s operator, Adura, said on Monday as it announced the start of gas…

top_signals.title: Tech Firms Dismantle Botnet That Turned 1.3M TV Boxes Into Proxies
top_signals.summary: Google said today it worked with industry partners to dismantle a botnet made up of more than 1.3 million Android TV set-top boxes that ship with malicious software which secretly rents the user's Internet connection out to strangers and conducts advertising fraud. Experts involved in the takedown say the action is likely to sever the botnet's access to more than 10 million additional compromised systems, including other Internet of Things (IoT) products such as Android-based healthcare devices and karaoke machines.

top_signals.title: Microsoft Fixes Nearly 1,100 Security Vulnerabilities
top_signals.summary: Microsoft did another four-digit patch drop today, releasing updates to fix almost 1,100 security vulnerabilities in its Windows operating systems and supported software. This month's Patch Tuesday addresses 63 critical flaws -- including a zero-day in Microsoft Outlook -- and comes amid important security updates from other software makers, including Adobe, Apple, Google and Mozilla.

top_signals.summary: In the biggest overhaul of the country’s spy laws of the postwar era, the Bundestag approved the bill by 308 votes to 190 — with 71 abstentions — months after Chancellor Friedrich Merz’s cabinet signed off on the draft.

top_signals.title: India Regulator Seeks Review of Top Court’s Yes Bank Bond Ruling
top_signals.summary: India’s central bank has asked the top court to review its decision setting aside the write-off of Yes Bank Ltd.’s riskier bonds, a verdict that could set a precedent for future bank rescues and weigh on the lender’s profitability.
